nodes.label: Hermes dashboard is DESIGNED for local-only access. CORS is restricted to localhost origins; PTY WebSocket explicitly rejects non-loopback peers even though uvicorn binds 127.0.0.1.
Chat via the dashboard = PTY WebSocket to a spawned `hermes --tui` binary. No JSON send-a-message endpoint exists.
The AIAgent Python class lives at /usr/local/lib/hermes-agent/run_agent.py — this is what our wrapper (TS-013 WI-2) will import.
For team-chat access from Vercel: TS-013 builds a small FastAPI adapter that imports AIAgent, exposes /v1/chat/stream (SSE), runs alongside (not replacing) Hermes's own dashboard.
Hermes's own state.db is NOT the source of truth for our team chat — our Supabase chat_messages table (with RLS) is. Hermes is used purely as the agent runtime.
GET /api/status — health check for the wrapper's Hermes availability
